comment: PEDAL BUILD manifest for HorizonL (9-knob): Horizon (fxid 419) with its reverb tank at half rate (22.05 kHz): half the work and memory traffic, for chains where Horizon crackles. Hi tops out at 10 kHz.
fxid_comment: 0x01A4. Project reserved Delay block, next to Horizon (419).

params.name: Size
params.comment: params[5]. The space, a room to a cathedral (the delay lines x0.35 .. x1.52); turning it bends the pitch of the tail.

params.name: Decay
params.comment: params[6]. Reverb time, about 0.8 s to a minute; 100 holds the tail forever and stops taking new sound.

params.name: Mod
params.comment: params[8]. Slow movement of the delay lines: chorus in the tail, shimmer at the top.

params.name: Lo
params.comment: params[9]. Low cut inside the tail, 20 .. 600 Hz.

params.name: Hi
params.comment: params[10]. High cut inside the tail, 1.5 .. 10 kHz: dark to bright.

params.name: Swell
params.comment: params[11]. Each note blooms into the reverb, over up to 2 s; 0 off.

params.name: Width
params.comment: params[12]. Stereo width of the tail, mono .. extra wide.
